'''Soup Joumou''' ({{IPAc-en|dʒ|uː|m|uː}}; {{langx|fr|soupe au giraumon}}, lit. ‘pumpkin soup’) is a [[soup]] native to [[Haitian cuisine]]. In 2021, soup joumou was added to the [[UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage List]].
